extensions.name: Code review
extensions.description: Adds /review to get a focused review of your code or an attached file.
extensions.author: Meteor

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review code for bugs, security and clarity
commands.prompt:
Review the following code. List concrete problems first (bugs, security issues, unhandled errors), ordered by severity, each with the line or snippet and a suggested fix. Then list smaller clarity or style improvements. If the code looks fine, say so plainly.

{{input}}

extensions.name: Commit writer
extensions.description: Adds /commit to turn a diff or a description of your changes into a clear commit message.
extensions.author: Meteor

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Write a commit message for your changes
commands.prompt:
Write a Conventional Commits message for these changes. Use a subject line of 72 characters or fewer, then a short body explaining why the change was made. Do not invent changes that are not described.

{{input}}

extensions.name: Explain code
extensions.description: Adds /explain for plain-language walkthroughs of code, errors and concepts.
extensions.author: Meteor

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explain code or an error in plain language
commands.prompt:
Explain the following in plain language for someone who is new to it. Start with a one-sentence summary, then walk through the important parts step by step. Point out anything surprising.

{{input}}

extensions.name: Concise mode
extensions.description: Keeps answers short and direct by adding a style instruction to every chat.
extensions.author: Meteor
extensions.instructions: Keep answers short and direct. Lead with the answer or the code, skip preambles and recaps, and only explain when the user asks or when something is non-obvious.

extensions.name: Memory
extensions.description: A persistent knowledge-graph memory for Meteor, via the official MCP memory server. Mention @memory to use it.
extensions.author: Model Context Protocol

extensions.name: Sequential thinking
extensions.description: Step-by-step problem solving for hard tasks, via the official MCP sequential-thinking server.
extensions.author: Model Context Protocol
